  "title": "Don't set MATOMO_SESSID in opt-out iFrame",

      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "Added this to the cookies list faq:  https://matomo.org/faq/general/faq_146/\r\n\r\n> Also when the opt-out feature is used, there is a cookie called `MATOMO_SESSID` being created, this cookie is only temporary (it is called a nonce and helps prevent CSRF security issues).\r\n"
